profile.summary: Digital4Good, which also operates as #ICANHELP, is an educational nonprofit focused on digital citizenship and online safety. It provides curricula, workshops and presentations to schools, and runs student clubs, internships and volunteer programs. It works with students, parents and educators.

sources.title: Digital4Good: Empowering Students in Digital Citizenship & Safety
